tabs.title: Colors
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: Dopamine 2.0's complete color system extracted from the Figma foundation file. 12 primitive palettes with 10–14 tonal stops each, plus semantic tokens. Production hex values from #FF6F61 (Living Coral) through the full Cool Neutral scale.

blocks.text: Production reference — Disabled fill: #E0E0E0 · Disabled text: #A9A9A9 · Primary text: #3B3B3B · Success fill: #208376 · Container: #FFFFFF

sections.title: White + Alpha
sections.description: White (#FFFFFF) at 10% through 100% opacity. Used for overlays, content-inverse hierarchy on dark backgrounds (shades 10 and 20).

sections.title: Semantic Token Mapping
sections.description: Semantic colours reference primitive scale stops. These tokens are used in components rather than raw hex values.

sections.title: HIH (Health Insights) Special Colors
sections.description: Five severity levels for Health Insights Hub data visualization: Normal, Borderline Abnormal, Needs Monitoring, Needs Attention, Needs Immediate Attention.

tabs.title: Typography
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: Figtree as the default typeface, Cabinet Grotesk Variable for display. Five groups: Display, Heading, Body, Tag. Naming convention: Group/Size/Weight(Name) e.g. Heading/32/700(Bold)

notes.label: Font families
notes.text: Figtree — Regular 400, Medium 500, Bold 700, ExtraBold 800. Default for all UI. Cabinet Grotesk Variable — Light 300, ExtraBold 800. Display sizes only.

sections.title: Additional
sections.description: Body/Small (Bold, Medium, Regular), Heading/XS/Semibold, Body/Medium variants, Tag/Offer/Coupon, Tag/SKU Regular, Tag/SKU Bold — specialized product UI typography.

tabs.title: Spacing
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: Global 8-point system. Baseline 8px multiplied for consistency. Smaller 2px and 4px for fine control.

tabs.title: Corner Radius
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: 8 tokens from 0px to 24px. Figma tokens: cr-s-4, cr-m-8, cr-12, cr-16, cr-xl (24).

tabs.title: Shadows & Elevation
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: Elevation tokens: midRaised with configurable blur, spread, x, y.

tabs.title: Gradients
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: 11 families × 3 intensities (light, regular, intense) = 33 gradient tokens.

tabs.title: Grid & Layout
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: 24px base grid. Mobile: 6 columns, 16px margins, 8px gutter. Desktop/Tablet: flexible multi-column.

notes.label: Mobile — 6 columns
notes.text: 6 columns, 16px side margins, 8px gutter. Based on 1mg mobile production layout.

tabs.title: Iconography
tabs.label: Foundation
tabs.description: 4 sizes × 5 states. Icon size rule: match text's line-height, or one step smaller.

tabs.title: Buttons
tabs.label: Component
tabs.description: 6 button types extracted from Figma and matched against 1mg mobile production. Primary action color: #FF6F61 (Living Coral). Disabled fill: #E0E0E0, disabled text: #A9A9A9.

sections.title: Standard Button — Fill
sections.description: Primary action button used across 1mg for CTAs like "Continue", "Add to Cart", "Buy now". Coral fill (#FF6F61), white text, 8px radius. Production: used in action bars, checkout, PDP.

sections.title: Standard Button — Outline
sections.description: Used for secondary actions and the ADD button on product cards. Light gray border (#dde2eb), coral text, white background, 8px radius. This is the most common button on 1mg mobile product listings.

sections.title: Standard Button — Ghost
sections.description: Text-only action link with no border or fill. Used for tertiary actions, "See all" links, and navigation text.

sections.title: Disabled State
sections.description: Production: fill = #E0E0E0, text = #A9A9A9. Used when action is unavailable (sold out, loading, invalid).

sections.title: Inverse State
sections.description: White fill or outline on dark backgrounds. Used on banners, overlays, and image-heavy sections.

sections.title: PDP Bottom Bar (1mg Production)
sections.description: Sticky bottom bar from the product detail page. Contains quantity counter, "Buy now" ghost button, and "ADD" filled CTA.

sections.title: Add to Cart Variants
sections.description: Commerce-specific button with quantity states. Matches 1mg mobile product cards.

sections.title: Special Button
sections.description: Black rounded pill button for hero sections, promotional banners. High-contrast placement.

sections.title: Floating Action Button (FAB)
sections.description: Two states: collapsed (icon-only circle) and expanded (icon + text pill). Used for primary page-level actions like "Upload prescription".

sections.title: Icon Button
sections.description: Icon-only button for compact actions. Grey variant for low-contrast backgrounds, White for dark backgrounds.

tabs.title: Input Fields
tabs.label: Component
tabs.description: Floating label input from 1mg production. Default: label sits inside as placeholder. On focus: label floats up onto the top border with a white background cutout. 5 states, 4 types.

notes.label: Behavior
notes.text: Default → label is inside the box, vertically centered, acting as placeholder. On tap/focus → label animates up to sit on the top border line with a white background behind it, border darkens.

sections.title: Default State
sections.description: Label sits inside the field as placeholder text. Border: #bec5d1.

sections.title: Focused / Typing State
sections.description: Label floats to top border. Border thickens and darkens to #414752. Cursor active inside.

sections.title: Error State
sections.description: Border and label turn #C50F1F. Helper text below with error message.

sections.title: Success State
sections.description: Border and label turn #308956. Helper text with checkmark.

sections.title: Disabled State
sections.description: Background fills to #F7F8FA. Label and text muted. Not interactive.

sections.title: Dropdown (Production)
sections.description: Select field matching Dropdown-module from 1mg. Caret icon on right.

sections.title: Field with CTA Button
sections.description: Input paired with an inline CTA, used for coupon codes and lead forms. From PrimaryButtonNew-module with coral variant.
